en.note:
You are dragged into another world; the aether in the middle can now be attacked: break it
If Doomtrain's magic reaches 100 before it breaks = wipe

Ghost trains run on two tracks: the outer (high) one and the inner (low) one
The outer one fires at the non-tanks / the inner one fires cone AoEs at the 2 tanks (next steps)

กลุ่ม MT = MT D1 D3 H1 / กลุ่ม ST = ST D2 D4 H2

ตามที่ออกแบบมา AoE วงกลมจะเคลื่อนตามเส้นทางรูปข้าวหลามตัด แล้วระเบิดตรงที่บอสกำมือ พร้อม stack ที่ Tank 1 คนกับ Healer 1 คน ทำแบบนี้ 3 ครั้ง

This plan (2:6) doesn't dodge it: it takes it head-on with mitigation and a level 2 tank LB

en.name: Tip: 15–20 s mitigation can cover two
en.note:
15–20 s mitigation used a little late can cover two Arcane Revelations
e.g. Expedient (Scholar) and Holos (Sage) last 20 s and can cover two if timed well
15 s mitigation covers two if the circle moves only a few times

The rule: use yours on your group's turn; if it also covers the next one, that's a bonus

en.name: Head-on Emission: how to read it
en.note:
Head-on Emission: a high / low AoE
Low-level AoE: blue lightning from the boss's mouth → go up (by the teleporter)
High-level AoE: the headlight (the top of the boss) glows orange-red → go down

It comes twice in the order they glow: remember which colour came first
refs: Blue lightning from the mouth = low AoE; go up
The headlight glows orange-red = high AoE; go down
